outcome: mildly elevated serum creatine kinase levels
cohort: A 4-year-old girl diagnosed with Musculocontractural Ehlers-Danlos syndrome.
finding: A novel mutation in the CHST14 gene was identified in a 4-year-old girl presenting with Musculocontractural Ehlers-Danlos syndrome and multisystemic involvement, highlighting diagnostic challenges with congenital neuromuscular disorders.
